rules: Compare each RUN-049 current-source facet only with its matching RUN-048 blind-neutral facet.
Count equivalent observable outcomes without prescribing a technical mechanism.
Apply segmented or downloadable, precomputed or reused, and asynchronous-delivery clauses only when the corresponding facility is present.
Do not infer runtime, browser, test, release, benchmark, mapping, final-no-match, or completion credit from this clean static comparison.

facets.strengths: Read-only projection exposes balances, entries, discrepancies, destructions, and loss reports.
facets.gaps: Generic medications.view replaces exact register authority; Site filter lacks explicit validation; full ledger derivation, stable snapshot, provenance, minimization, and foreign-Site denial are unproved.
facets.native_preserve: Existing controlled-drug read page, Client-view filtering, and non-mutating projection.

facets.strengths: Creates register evidence, updates stock and schedules when medication resolves, and separately checks witness permission.
facets.gaps: Broad orders.manage substitutes for exact action authority; Site and ownership checks are absent; nullable medication permits unbound entries; writes lack transactions, locks, and durable actor/payload-bound replay.
facets.native_preserve: Movement categories, register-entry model, witness permission check, and schedule synchronization.

facets.strengths: Core writes are transactional, witness permission is checked, and discrepancy/incident/alert integration exists.
facets.gaps: No exact balance-check or actor-Site authority; nullable medication can break provenance and mismatch handling; the check can mutate stock; stock is unlocked and replay cache is non-durable.
facets.native_preserve: Core transaction, witness evidence, and discrepancy/incident/alert integrations.

facets.strengths: Records resolution evidence and invokes alert/signal resolution.
facets.gaps: Broad permission and direct binding lack Site checks; status/evidence are overwritten without open-state or revision protection; alert resolution is non-atomic; no lock, transaction, replay identity, or linked correction contract exists.

facets.strengths: The page projects destruction evidence; creation is transactional and conditionally locks linked stock; the external command is correctly attributed to CAP-MED-DESTRUCTION.
facets.gaps: No exact projection authority or ownership-consistent Site boundary; void metadata is omitted, void does not reverse stock/register movement, and destruction may lack a disposal entry; as-of, rule-version, reconciliation, and snapshot guarantees are absent.
facets.native_preserve: Current projection/model, transactional creation, conditional stock lock, and separate CAP-MED-DESTRUCTION ownership.

facets.strengths: medications.controlled.witness is checked separately and witness identity is stored.
facets.gaps: No separately governed contemporaneous attestation, Site overlap, assignment, competency, independence, exact payload/revision binding, eligibility snapshot, durable replay, race protection, or direct-object concealment is established.
facets.native_preserve: Separate witness permission check and stored witness identity.

rollup.summary: Useful native projections, evidence models, and integrations exist, but every facet conflicts with at least one essential authority, ownership, atomicity, replay, or privacy requirement.

facets.strengths: AR/AP rows are permission-partitioned and Site-filtered; all-Sites broadens scope only; allocations are immutable and traceable rows are distinguished from legacy-review rows.
facets.gaps: Generic AR/AP view replaces exact history authority; complete omission-aware chronology and arithmetic are unproved; no stable as-of snapshot or complete supported-path concealment evidence exists.
facets.native_preserve: Read-only controller, immutable allocation model, AR/AP partitioning, Site-scope service, and legacy-review distinction.

facets.strengths: List scope, deterministic proposal keys, rejection-version progression, bank-transaction locking, and command-time current-target rechecks exist.
facets.gaps: Generic bank.view replaces exact review authority; list review does not re-prove current target Site; rationale, input cutoff, rule version, staleness, and reused-proposal isolation are incomplete; view-only UI exposes command controls.
facets.native_preserve: Proposal/version model, stored-Site filtering, generation lock, immutable rejection, and route-level bank.manage command enforcement.

facets.strengths: One locked transaction posts validated AP/AR allocation, journal, settlement, and target state; evidence-conditioned replay is an acceptable equivalent outcome; inaccessible or Site-mismatched targets receive concealed 404s.
facets.gaps: Generic finance.bank.manage replaces exact confirm authority and also owns adjacent actions; provenance lacks a complete logical-operation binding despite strong canonical journal/allocation evidence.
facets.native_preserve: Existing lock order, atomic posting, sign/due checks, evidence-conditioned replay, canonical Site rechecks, and concealed mismatch behavior.

facets.strengths: Locked transactional rejection is immutable, records actor/time/reason, rejects repeats without duplication, gives later suggestions new versions, and applies concealed current-target Site checks.
facets.gaps: Generic finance.bank.manage replaces exact reject authority and also authorizes confirm; full suggestion-version, object-state, source, and logical-operation provenance is not established.
facets.native_preserve: Proposal lock, fail-closed audit transaction, immutable rejection evidence, version regeneration, and concealed Site boundary.

facets.strengths: Producer-specific exact actions and Site concealment remain intact; append-only settlement evidence, recorder uniqueness, and producer locks prevent duplicate canonical sources.
facets.gaps: There is no uniform durable operation/content binding, original authorization context, recovery-state projection, delegated-worker contract, deterministic uncertain-outcome recovery, or target-wide replay semantics.
facets.native_preserve: Producer ownership, canonical target/Site checks, settlement recorder uniqueness, locks, and allocation/journal provenance.

rollup.summary: Confirm and reject retain strong native atomicity, replay, and concealment outcomes, but generic action permissions contradict exact facet ownership and review/recovery contracts remain incomplete.
